summary.en: Ride across the foothills with your guide. You stop at the gate, at the barn and out among the cattle, and at each stop you learn a piece of how Canada earns its living, then answer questions about it.
summary.fr: Traversez les contreforts à cheval avec votre guide. Vous vous arrêtez à la barrière, à la grange et au milieu du troupeau; à chaque halte, vous apprenez un aspect de la façon dont le Canada gagne sa vie, puis vous répondez à des questions dessus.

text.en: That is fine. The horses will wait. Come and find me when you want to ride.
text.fr: C'est bien ainsi. Les chevaux vont attendre. Venez me voir quand vous voudrez partir.

text.en: Keep riding along the fence line. The gate comes first, then the barn, then the cattle.
text.fr: Continuez à chevaucher le long de la clôture. La barrière vient en premier, puis la grange, puis le troupeau.

text.en: Alberta also has the Badlands. Their rough ground holds some of the richest beds of dinosaur bones and old fossils in the world.
text.fr: L'Alberta a aussi les Badlands. Leur sol accidenté renferme parmi les plus riches gisements d'ossements de dinosaures et de vieux fossiles au monde.

source.quote: The rugged Badlands house some of the world’s richest deposits of prehistoric fossils and dinosaur finds.

verification.evidence: Alberta is the most populous Prairie province. … The rugged Badlands house some of the world’s richest deposits of prehistoric fossils and dinosaur finds.

text.en: You rode the whole spread with me, from the gate out to the herd, and answered everything I asked about Canada's economy.
text.fr: Vous avez parcouru tout le domaine avec moi, de la barrière jusqu'au troupeau, et répondu à tout ce que je vous ai demandé sur l'économie du Canada.

prompt.en: Meet your guide before the ride
prompt.fr: Retrouvez votre guide avant de partir

text.en: Good morning! Take the reins. We ride from here.
text.fr: Bonjour! Prenez les rênes. On part d'ici.

text.en: Alberta has national parks. Banff National Park was created in 1885.
text.fr: L'Alberta a des parcs nationaux. Le parc national Banff a été créé en 1885.

source.quote: Alberta has five national parks, including Banff National Park, established in 1885.

verification.evidence: Alberta is the most populous Prairie province. … Alberta has five national parks, including Banff National Park, established in 1885.

text.en: Alberta is known for farming too. Its big cattle ranches help make Canada one of the world's main beef producers.
text.fr: L'Alberta est aussi reconnue pour l'agriculture. Ses grands ranchs de bétail aident à faire du Canada un des principaux producteurs de bœuf au monde.

source.quote: Alberta is also renowned for agriculture, especially for the vast cattle ranches that make Canada one of the world’s major beef producers.

verification.evidence: Alberta is also renowned for agriculture, especially for the vast cattle ranches that make Canada one of the world’s major beef producers.

text.en: Follow the trail. We pull up three times, and I have something for you at each stop.
text.fr: Suivez la piste. On s'arrête trois fois, et j'ai quelque chose pour vous à chaque halte.

prompt.en: Ride up to the ranch gate
prompt.fr: Rendez-vous à la barrière du ranch

text.en: Hold up at the gate. Before we reach the ranch, one thing about the rest of the country's work.
text.fr: Arrêtez-vous à la barrière. Avant d'arriver au ranch, une chose sur le reste du travail au pays.

text.en: Service industries give people thousands of different kinds of job: transport, schools, health care, building, banking, shops, tourism, government.
text.fr: Les industries de services offrent aux gens des milliers de métiers différents : transport, écoles, soins de santé, construction, banques, commerces, tourisme, fonction publique.

source.quote: Service industries provide thousands of different jobs in areas like transportation, education, health care, construction, banking, communications, retail services, tourism and government.

verification.evidence: CANADA’S ECONOMY INCLUDES THREE MAIN TYPES OF INDUSTRIES: … Service industries provide thousands of different jobs in areas like transportation, education, health care, construction, banking, communications, retail services, tourism and government.

prompt.en: Answer 2 questions about the kinds of work in Canada
prompt.fr: Répondez à 2 questions sur les types d'emplois au Canada

text.en: Tie up here. What leaves this barn is raw, and raw is not the only thing this country sells.
text.fr: Attachez le cheval ici. Ce qui sort de cette grange est brut, et le brut n'est pas la seule chose que ce pays vend.

text.en: Manufacturing makes goods to sell at home and abroad: paper, high-tech equipment, aerospace technology, cars, machines, food and clothing.
text.fr: La fabrication produit des biens à vendre au pays et à l'étranger : papier, équipement de haute technologie, technologie aérospatiale, automobiles, machines, aliments et vêtements.

source.quote: Manufacturing industries make products to sell in Canada and around the world. Manufactured products include paper, high technology equipment, aerospace technology, automobiles, machinery, food, clothing and many other goods.

verification.evidence: CANADA’S ECONOMY INCLUDES THREE MAIN TYPES OF INDUSTRIES: … Manufacturing industries make products to sell in Canada and around the world. Manufactured products include paper, high technology equipment, aerospace technology, automobiles, machinery, food, clothing and many other goods.

prompt.en: Answer 3 questions about what Canada makes and sells
prompt.fr: Répondez à 3 questions sur ce que le Canada produit et vend

text.en: Walk your horse through them, slowly. One last thing, about where all this goes.
text.fr: Passez au pas au milieu du troupeau. Une dernière chose, sur la destination de tout cela.

text.en: Every year Canada sells energy, machines and equipment, cars, farm goods, fish, wood and everyday goods to other countries.
text.fr: Chaque année, le Canada vend à d'autres pays de l'énergie, des machines et de l'équipement, des automobiles, des produits de la ferme, du poisson, du bois et des biens de tous les jours.

source.quote: Canada exports billions of dollars worth of energy products, industrial goods, machinery, equipment, automotive, agricultural, fishing and forestry products, and consumer goods every year.

verification.evidence: Natural resources industries include forestry, fishing, agriculture, mining and energy. … a large percentage of Canada’s exports are natural resources commodities. … Canada exports billions of dollars worth of energy products, industrial goods, machinery, equipment, automotive, agricultural, fishing and forestry products, and consumer goods every year.

prompt.en: Answer 2 questions about what Canada sells to other countries
prompt.fr: Répondez à 2 questions sur ce que le Canada vend à d'autres pays
